thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert: inference-api 5xx spike detected (error rate 18%) rolling across eu-west-1. Paging oncall.
Priya K: Got the page, looking. I'm live on the runbook now.
Ben M: I'm joining — will check autoscaler and pod OOMs first. Any customer-facing impact?
Priya K: Yes, some customer requests are timing out with 502s. Not seeing full saturation but error rate rising.
Ava S: I'm watching support queue, flagging customers with active SLAs. Sending an initial note to affected accounts.
Ben M: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` shows burst of `OOMKilled` on model-host-2 and host-3 around 03:12 UTC. Restart loop on host-3.
Priya K: Rolling restart of model-host-3 initiated. Also toggled scale-up to add two instances as temp mitigation.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: Canary rollout for model v3.2 paused due to errors at 03:15 UTC.
Priya K: Pause canary, we didn't start a deploy manually. Reverting scaling policy to normal after extra nodes came up.
Ben M: Traces show a spike in sequence length for a small subset of requests — some customers sent long prompts. Bumping kv-cache memory allowed more stability.
Leon R: From security: we need to capture evidence for the 03:10–03:30 window for post-incident review. Please don't purge infra logs.
Priya K: Acknowledged. Ben, can you snapshot the pod logs and kernel messages?
Ben M: Preparing a tarball of `/var/log/pods/inference/*` and `dmesg` output. Uploading to secure S3: `s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1920001234/`
Ben M: Done. Files: `pods-1920001234.tgz` `dmesg-1920001234.txt`. Permissions restricted to infra+security.
audit-bot: Note: audit logs for the K8s API between 03:05–03:20 UTC show sampling enabled; full audit events not retained for this namespace due to policy.
Leon R: That's a problem for compliance — we need full audit coverage for incidents that affect customer data. Opening a tracking ticket.
Ava S: Customer comms: sent interim message to five impacted tenants at 03:25 UTC. No PII exposed as far as we can tell.
Priya K: Stabilized. Error rate back to baseline ~1.2% after scale and cache adjustments. Root cause likely a combination of unexpectedly long sequences + an aggressive memory limit bump in a recent node profile.
Ben M: We'll annotate the failing nodes and reproduce locally with a synthetic long-seq workload.
Priya K: Oncall handoff to Sam N in 30min. Sam, I'll leave the incident trace and evidence links in the incident doc.
Sam N: Thanks, taking handoff. Please include runbook steps you executed.
Priya K: Added actions to the incident doc: rollback canary if seen; monitor error rate for 2hrs; keep evidence bucket intact.
Leon R: Security follow-up items: 1) Collect missing API audit events — request EKS control plane logs from cloud provider, 2) Lock down kube-apiserver audit policy to capture full events for sensitive namespaces, 3) Confirm role bindings for incident buckets. I'll own 1 & 2.
Ben M: Ops follow-ups: 1) INF-3421: increase pod memory soft limit for model-hosts under high-seqlen, 2) INF-3422: add synthetic seqlen test to CI, 3) INF-3423: add alerting to detect batch-seq-length anomalies. I'll own these.
Ava S: CS follow-ups: draft postmortem customer note and prepare compensation guidance if SLA impacted.
Priya K: Scheduling postmortem: propose 2025-09-12 15:00 UTC. Leon, Ben, Ava, Sam can you make that?
Leon R: Confirmed.
Ben M: Confirmed.
Ava S: Confirmed.
Sam N: Confirmed.
Priya K: Created JIRA INF-POST-1920001234 with owners and initial timeline. Tagging infra, security, cs. Please add any evidence links.
Ben M: Added `s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1920001234/pods-1920001234.tgz` and `/logs/trace-1920001234.json` to the ticket.
Leon R: Note: audit-bot flagged a gap — the root cause here includes a compliance risk (audit sampling). Creating compliance PR to change cluster audit config; will send to infra for review.
Ava S: I'll prep a short customer-facing summary for the postmortem, include timeline and mitigation steps.
Priya K: Action items recap (quick):
- Leon: request full control-plane logs from cloud provider + PR to change audit policy (due 2025-09-15).
- Ben: INF-3421/3422/3423 triage & apply fixes (due 2025-09-18).
- Ava: customer note draft (due 2025-09-13).
- Priya: finalize postmortem doc & runbook edits (due 2025-09-14).
- Sam: monitor errors for the next 2 hours and escalate if >3%
Priya K: Closing incident thread for now, will reopen if regressions. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
